frozenDefinitions.common: Completed five-minute bars only; next-bar open; one signal per symbol/day; minimum stop distance 0.10 percent, maximum 2.5 percent. VWAP uses RTH cumulative typical-price times volume. Long and short are directional diagnostics, not executed stock trades. Stop first if stop and target occur inside one bar; adverse gap fills; missing held observations invalidate qualification.
frozenDefinitions.opening-range-continuation: First 15-minute range. Close outside opening range and on same side of VWAP. Stop at opposite range boundary. Entry no farther than 0.25 opening-range widths beyond broken boundary.
frozenDefinitions.failed-opening-range-breakout: Previous completed close outside opening range; current close back inside. Trade toward range interior; stop at previous bar extreme plus/minus 0.01.
frozenDefinitions.vwap-trend-pullback: Previous two closes on same side of their respective session VWAP values; current VWAP slope agrees; signal bar touches VWAP and closes back on trend side. Stop at extreme of previous two bars plus signal bar.
frozenDefinitions.vwap-overextension-reversal: Previous close at least 0.75 percent from its session VWAP; signal close moves toward current VWAP by at least 0.10 percent of previous close while remaining on original extended side. Stop at extreme of previous two bars plus signal bar.

limitations: Present-day fixed universe and short sample are selected retrospectively; no untouched holdout is claimed.
Short directional returns exclude stock borrow and are not executable account PnL.
Five-minute OHLC cannot establish intrabar liquidity, queue position or exact fill times.
Four families share market exposures; bootstrap is descriptive and does not establish options edge or eliminate selection bias.
No same-day profit or annual return forecast; no historical news filter without receipt-time evidence.
